geometry_hash_scope: Complete geometry JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.
method: All 51 positions of the closed source ring were rendered in longitude/latitude with latitude-adjusted aspect. The complete shape was visually compared with Figures 1 and 14. Source and decoded baseline ring order and six-decimal coordinate rounding were independently checked. No georeferenced raster overlap or shoreline survey was performed.

region_checks.observation: The northern narrow rounded lobe and the west-bank indentation below it occur in both the source outline and plan maps.
The lake widens toward the southeast and terminates in a broad rounded southern shore in both the source and provincial map panels.
Lake Winnipegosis is drawn separately to the north, reached through Mossy River; the target remains confined to the southern lake.
Figure 14 distinguishes adjacent marsh-management areas. Their exact boundary against the generalized source outline is not resolved.

station_checks.observation: The outlet station falls near the northern end of the generalized polygon.
The Ochre Beach station is near the southwestern shore, just outside the generalized ring; station placement is not a shoreline-boundary test.

name_extent_assessment: Whole-outline evidence supports Dauphin Lake at generalized map scale. No inspected evidence requires treating the target as a compound of separate named lakes.
precision_limits: The source is a generalized Natural Earth 1:10 million polygon; mapped marsh margins and detailed shoreline differences are unresolved.
The plan is a historical planning document; PDF creation and modification dates are file metadata, not verified publication or present shoreline dates.
ECCC station coordinates and names confirm regional usage at two sites, not whole-lake boundaries.
No formal naming instrument, current registry status, exact shoreline fit, Korean name or legally defined name extent was established.
